{{Header Nav|game=The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time}}
{{control selector|N64, GameCube, Wii Classic Controller, 3DS, Switch}}

The following page lists all of the enemies that Link faces in his travels. They are listed according to the time period and location in which they are introduced.
__TOC__

==Young Link==
=== Great Deku Tree ===
{|{{prettytable|sortable=1}}
!width="200px"|Enemy!!HP!!Damage dealt!!Location first seen!!Locations!!Navi description!!Notes

{{LoZOoT/Enemy
|name=Deku Baba (withered)
|hp=1
|damage=½ Heart
|first=Kokiri Village
|location=Kokiri Village
|navi=Though it looks withered, it will hurt you if you touch it.
|notes=This plant poses little threat and can only move its head circularly to attack. If touched, it will cause damage. A single blow will kill it, leaving a {{Im/oot|Consumables|Deku Stick}} if it is killed. In the Kokiri Village area, these plants are only found in the pathway leading to the Great Deku Tree.
}}

{{LoZOoT/Enemy
|name=Deku Baba
|hp=2
|damage=½ Heart
|first=Inside the Deku Tree
|location=Inside the Deku Tree
|navi=Hit it when it lunges at you, and it will stand upright. Cut it quickly to get a Deku Stick!
|notes=A stationary plant that will bite you if you're not careful. Unlike the withered variety, this plant has a limited reach of attack. Killing it while it is not attacking will yield a {{Im/oot|Consumables|Deku Nut}}, whereas attacking it in its extended position will stun it. Killing it in this stunned position will yield a {{Im/oot|Consumables|Deku Stick}}.|image=LoZ OoT enemy Deku Baba.jpg
}}

{{LoZOoT/Enemy
|name=Deku Scrub
|hp=2
|damage=½ Heart
|first=Inside the Deku Tree
|location=Inside the Deku Tree
|navi=It will hide in the grass if you get close to it. Bounce the nuts it spits back at it!
|notes=This creature pops up out of the ground and shoots Deku Nuts at you. Reflecting a Deku Nut back to the Deku Scrub will cause it to jump out of its hole. If left alone, it will eventually return to its hole. However, if it is caught, it will often offer information.
}}

{{LoZOoT/Enemy
|name=Skullwalltula
|hp=1
|damage=½ Heart
|first=Inside the Deku Tree
|location=Inside the Deku Tree, Death Mountain, Forest Temple
|navi=Be careful not to touch it!
|notes=This small spider-like creature resides on the walls. It will knock you off the walls as you climb if it touches you. When it is getting ready to attack you, it'll turn purple.
}}

{{LoZOoT/Enemy
|name=Skulltula
|hp=1
|damage=½ Heart
|first=Inside the Deku Tree
|location=Inside the Deku Tree, Forest Temple, Shadow Temple
|navi=Its soft belly is its weak point!
|notes=This Skulltula drops down suddenly, and makes a quick spin attack if you are too close. Attack it when its "soft belly" is exposed; hitting its hard shell only causes it to swing from side-to-side.
}}

{{LoZOoT/Enemy
|name=Big Skulltula
|hp=2
|damage=½ Heart
|first=Inside the Deku Tree
|location=Inside the Deku Tree
|navi=Its soft belly is its weak point!
|notes=Is a bigger version of the Skulltula.
}}

{{LoZOoT/Enemy
|name=Gold Skulltula
|hp=2
|damage=1 Heart
|first=Inside the Deku Tree
|location=Inside the Deku Tree
|navi=??
|notes=Gold Skulltulas are a rare breed of Skulltula. They are basically collectibles. Shoot and kill them to get '''Gold Skulltula Tokens'''[[File:OoT_Items_Gold_Skulltula_Token.png|x24px]]. There are 100 Gold Skulltulas in the game. Later on in the game, you can use these tokens to earn a series of prizes, such as the {{im/oot|Upgrades|Adult's Wallet}} at 10 tokens, the {{control|{{im/oot|Secrets|Stone of Agony}}|{{im/oot|Secrets|Stone of Agony}}|{{im/oot|Secrets|Stone of Agony}}|{{im/oot|Secrets|Shard of Agony}}|{{im/oot|Secrets|Stone of Agony}}}} at 20, the {{im/oot|Upgrades|Giant's Wallet}} at 30, some {{im/oot|Items|Bombchu|display=Bombchus}} at 40, a {{im/oot|Upgrades|Piece of Heart}} at 50, and lastly, a {{im/oot|Consumables|Huge Rupee}} that can be collected indefinitely when you collect all 100. For more information on them, consult the [[../Gold Skulltulas|Gold Skulltula Mini-Quest Section]].
|image=OOT skulltula small.png
}}

{{LoZOoT/Enemy
|name=Gohma Larva
|hp=2
|damage=½ Heart
|first=Inside the Deku Tree
|location=Inside the Deku Tree, Dodongo's Cavern (Master Quest)
|navi=Look out when it gets ready to pounce!
|notes=This enemy attacks by hopping at you when its eye turns red. It usually takes two hits to kill. If you can shoot its egg with the {{im/oot|Items|Fairy Slingshot}} before it hatches, it'll die instantly.
|image2=LoZ OoT enemy Gohma Larva art.png
}}

{{LoZOoT/Enemy
|name=Queen Gohma: Parasitic Armored Arachnid
|hp=10
|damage=½ Heart
|first=Inside the Deku Tree
|location=Inside the Deku Tree
|navi=It's one of the parasitic monsters inside the Deku Tree! Its eye is vulnerable when it's red!
|notes=The boss of the Deku Tree dungeon. This large enemy attacks directly with her two upper appendages or indirectly by releasing Gohma Larva eggs. If these eggs are not destroyed, they will hatch into Gohma Larva. Its weak point is its eye. Hit the eye with the {{im/oot|Items|Fairy Slingshot}} or {{im/oot|Consumables|Deku Nut}} to stun it and attack it with your sword repeatedly. Try to hit it in the eye while it is on the ceiling to prevent it from releasing larva and making it easier to slay.
|image=LoZ OoT Queen Gohma art.jpg
}}
|}

===Hyrule Field===
{|{{prettytable|sortable=1}}
!width="200px"|Enemy!!HP!!Damage dealt!!Location first seen!!Locations!!Navi description!!Notes

{{LoZOoT/Enemy
|name=Peahat
|hp=6
|damage=1 heart
|first=Hyrule Field
|location=Hyrule Field
|navi=It's weak point is its roots!
|notes=This is a large, flying, spinning flower. As it spins, its roots will become visible. Attack these roots to defeat this enemy. This enemy does not attack at night. However, if struck at night, it releases Peahat Larva.
}}

{{LoZOoT/Enemy
|name=Peahat Larva
|hp=1
|damage=¼ heart
|first=Hyrule Field
|location=Hyrule Field
|navi=Defend with your shield!
|notes=This smaller version of the Peahat cannot be damaged by your sword. However, it can be blocked with your shield. Once tired or far away from the Peahat that spawned them, they will go away or will die if they plow into the ground.
}}

{{LoZOoT/Enemy
|name=Stalchild
|hp=2
|damage=¼ heart
|first=Hyrule Field
|location=Hyrule Field
|navi=Don't be afraid of the Stalchild! Just attack it repeatedly!
|notes=This skeletal enemy erupts from the ground after night falls. A horizontal slice with your sword will remove its head. Upon doing this, it has a harder time finding you. A vertical slice does equal damage but does not remove the head. Its slow movement makes it easy to avoid or defeat. Defeating a series of them in a row causes a large Stalchild to appear that will drop a better rewarding item or Rupee when defeated. Stalchildren can't swim or stay out in the daytime. They will ignore you if you ignore them and run off from them. If you wear the bunny hood, they will not pop out. Just as well, they won't pop out if you remain on one of the dirt paths.
}}
|}

=== Lon Lon Ranch ===
{|{{prettytable|sortable=1}}
!width="200px"|Enemy!!HP!!Damage dealt!!Location first seen!!Locations!!Navi description!!Notes
{{LoZOoT/Enemy
|name=Guay
|hp=1
|damage=¼ heart
|first=Lon Lon Ranch
|location=Lon Lon Ranch
|navi=Destroy it before it flies into you!
|notes=This black bird comes out at night, but you can see its shadow on the ground. Simply hit it with a weapon to destroy it. If enough Guay are killed, a large Guay will swoop down and attack. Killing it will make a {{Im/oot|Consumables|Red Rupee}} appear.
}}
|}

===Kakariko Village Graveyard===
{|{{prettytable|sortable=1}}
!width="200px"|Enemy!!HP!!Damage dealt!!Location first seen!!Locations!!Navi description!!Notes
{{LoZOoT/Enemy
|name=Poe
|hp=4
|damage=¼ heart
|first=Kakariko Village Graveyard
|location=Kakariko Village Graveyard
|navi=If you stare at it with Z Targeting, it will disappear...
|notes=This is a lantern wielding ghost that disappears when {{control|{{N64|Z}}|{{gc|L}}|{{wii-cc|L}}}}-targeted. If {{control|{{N64|Z}}|{{gc|L}}|{{wii-cc|L}}|{{3ds|L}}|{{Switch|ZL}}}}-targeting is held, however, it will reappear. After it's defeated, its {{im/oot|Items|Poe|display=essence}} can be captured in a bottle. Poes attack when their graves are disturbed or if you come up to their floating lanterns. The color of their eyes foretells how they will act. Green means they won't attempt to attack, yellow means you've angered them and they may attack, and red marks an incoming attack. They attack by wildly spinning their lanterns, even if they're visible.
|image=LoZ OoT enemy Poe.jpg
}}
{{LoZOoT/Enemy
|name=The Composer Brothers: Flat and Sharp
|hp=4
|damage=¼ heart
|first=Kakariko Village Graveyard
|location=Kakariko Village Graveyard
|navi=??
|notes=Two old composers who rest in their graves. Reading their graves will cause them to appear and attack you, but they can be disposed of just like normal Poes. When defeated, their spirits will be willing to talk to you, but can never be captured.
|image=LoZ OoT enemy Flat.png
|image2=LoZ OoT enemy Sharp.png
}}
|}

===Royal Family Tomb===
{|{{prettytable|sortable=1}}
!width="200px"|Enemy!!HP!!Damage dealt!!Location first seen!!Locations!!Navi description!!Notes
{{LoZOoT/Enemy
|name=Keese
|hp=1
|damage=½ heart
|first=Royal Tomb
|location=Royal Tomb, Dodongo's Cavern, Ice Cavern
|navi=When you get close to it, use Z Targeting. Even if it flies away, you can still target it.
|notes=This is a black bat. Although weak, it will set itself alight if a fire is nearby, becoming a Fire Keese; if Blue Fire is around, it will become an Ice Keese. Although a quick sword-swipe will kill them, they are best dispatched with the Slingshot or the Boomerang. They usually nest in certain spots and don't move unless startled, which will trigger an attack.
}}
{{LoZOoT/Enemy
|name=ReDead
|hp=8
|damage=¼ heart per second
|first=Royal Tomb
|location=Royal Tomb, Castle Town (adult), Bottom of the Well, Shadow Temple
|navi=Its gaze will paralyze you. If it bites you, tap any button to escape!
|notes=This is a restless undead creature. It moves slowly but has a paralyzing shriek. The {{im/oot|Ocarina Songs|Sun's Song}} renders them inert for a moderate amount of time. These enemies are best avoided early in the game. Their attack consists of jumping onto Link's back and leeching life from him, taking away ¼ of a heart per second. Rapidly tapping a button is the only means of escape. If one of their brethren dies, they go to where the body lies, ignoring Link. Some ReDeads may crouch, and those that do can't shriek until they get up.
}}
|}

===Sacred Forest Meadow===
{|{{prettytable|sortable=1}}
!width="200px"|Enemy!!HP!!Damage dealt!!Location first seen!!Locations!!Navi description!!Notes
{{LoZOoT/Enemy

|hp=2
|damage=½ heart
|first=Dodongo's Cavern
|location=Dodongo's Cavern

}}
{{LoZOoT/Enemy
|name=Fire Keese
|hp=1
|damage=½ heart

|location=Dodongo's Cavern

{{LoZOoT/Enemy
|name=King Dodongo: Infernal Dinosaur
|hp=4
|damage=½ heart (fire breath), ¼ heart (roll)
|first=Dodongo's Cavern
|location=Dodongo's Cavern
|navi=This is a huge Dodongo that eats anything! Give it a shock, and finish it off with your sword!
|notes=The boss of Dodongo's Cavern. It can produce a fiery breath and roll around the edge of the room. It is vulnerable when it is preparing for its fiery attack. Tossing a bomb into its mouth stuns it. Slash it repeatedly until it curls up into a ball and rolls around. Make certain that you have the {{im/oot|Equipment|Hylian Shield}} equipped as it will protect you from the monster's rolling attack. If you employ the {{im/oot|Items|Deku Stick}} and jump slash the creature, it will perish very quickly.
|image=LoZ OoT enemy King Dodongo.png
}}
|}

===Zora's River===
{|{{prettytable|sortable=1}}
!width="200px"|Enemy!!HP!!Damage dealt!!Location first seen!!Locations!!Navi description!!Notes

}}
|}

===Jabu-Jabu's Belly===
{|{{prettytable|sortable=1}}
!width="200px"|Enemy!!HP!!Damage dealt!!Location first seen!!Locations!!Navi description!!Notes
{{LoZOoT/Enemy
|name=Biri
|hp=1
|damage=½ heart
|first=Jabu-Jabu's Belly
|location=Jabu-Jabu's Belly
|navi=If you touch it, you will be electrocuted!
|notes=A jellyfish-like creature that floats slowly through the air. It may be easy to avoid, but it shocks you with electricity if you do not use ranged attacks. The {{im/oot|Items|Boomerang}} is the best weapon to use against it. The {{im/oot|Items|Fairy Slingshot}} is ineffective against it. A combination of {{im/oot|Items|Deku Nut|display=Deku Nuts}} to bring them down and hits with the sword to kill them can be used. The magical spin-attack attack works, but the range and timing are of such critical importance that it's just easier to use the boomerang. It is also possible to kill Biri by throwing Princess Ruto at them, but you will need to aim well.
}}
{{LoZOoT/Enemy
|name=Bari
|hp=1
|damage=½ heart (spin), 1 heart (shock/contact)
|first=Jabu-Jabu's Belly
|location=Jabu-Jabu's Belly
|navi=If you touch it, you will be electrocuted!
|notes=A tougher version of the Biri that splits into three Biri when defeated. It drops from the ceiling and causes more damage when it attacks. The {{im/oot|Items|Fairy Slingshot}} is ineffective against it, but the {{im/oot|Items|Boomerang}} works perfectly.
|image=LoZ OoT enemy Bari.png
}}
{{LoZOoT/Enemy
|name=Shabom
|hp=1
|damage=¼ heart
|first=Jabu-Jabu's Belly
|location=Jabu-Jabu's Belly
|navi=(''N64'') If you try to cut it, it will bounce off your blade!<br>(''GCN'') If you cut it, it will burst open and knock you back!<br>(''3D'') It's a big, floating bubble. Be careful not to touch it!
|notes=A bubble that floats toward you in a somewhat random way. If it pops near you, it will send you flying backward and damage you. Use a {{im/oot|Items|Deku Nut}} to cause all nearby Shaboms to pop, or the {{im/oot|Items|Boomerang}} for individuals. The {{im/oot|Items|Fairy Slingshot}} is ineffective against it. A jump slash with a {{im/oot|Items|Deku Stick}} provides adequate range to avoid its explosion upon its defeat. The magic spin-attack is also effective.
}}
{{LoZOoT/Enemy
|name=Tailpasaran
|hp=1
|damage=½ heart
|first=Jabu-Jabu's Belly
|location=Jabu-Jabu's Belly
|navi=Its tail is its weak point!
|notes=An armored enemy that shocks you if you slash it. Use {{control|{{N64|Z}}|{{gc|L}}|{{wii-cc|L}}{{3ds|L}}|{{Switch|ZL}}}}-targeting and throw the {{im/oot|Items|Boomerang}} at it or use the magic spin-attack to defeat it.
}}
{{LoZOoT/Enemy
|name=Stinger
|hp=2
|damage=½ heart
|first=Jabu-Jabu's Belly
|location=Jabu-Jabu's Belly
|navi=Destroy it before it flies into you!
|notes=An airborne enemy which attacks similarly like Guay and Keese. A jump slash or a hit from the {{im/oot|Items|Boomerang}} will defeat it.
}}
{{LoZOoT/Enemy
|name=Parasitic Tentacle
|hp=4
|damage=¼ heart
|first=Jabu-Jabu's Belly
|location=Jabu-Jabu's Belly
|navi=It seems that the narrow part is its weak point... You need a particular item to destroy it!
|notes=An appendage that retracts unless it thinks it can attack you. Draw it out by moving closer, and use {{control|{{N64|Z}}|{{gc|L}}|{{wii-cc|L}}{{3ds|L}}|{{Switch|ZL}}}}-targeting so you can attack with the {{im/oot|Items|Boomerang}} which will halt its attack. Its weak point is a narrow segment on its body.
}}
{{LoZOoT/Enemy
|name=Big Octo
|hp=4
|damage=½ heart
|first=Jabu-Jabu's Belly
|location=Jabu-Jabu's Belly
|navi=Attack it from behind!

Hitting the Big Octo in the back with the Boomerang stuns it and leaves it vulnerable to the {{im/oot|Items|Kokiri Sword}} in the back.
}}
{{LoZOoT/Enemy
|name=Barinade: Bio-Electric Anemone
|hp=15
|damage=??
|first=Jabu-Jabu's Belly
|location=Jabu-Jabu's Belly
|navi=Many parasitic jellyfish swarm around this monster. Aim for its body, protected by jellyfish!
|notes=The boss of Jabu-Jabu's Belly. Watch out for its electric beams that it constantly fires at you throughout the battle. In order to defeat it target the tentacles attached to the ceiling with the {{im/oot|Items|Boomerang}} first. Once they have been detached from the ceiling, attack the main body. It will begin to spin around attempting to run into you. Stun it with the Boomerang and destroy the Jellyfish protecting its weak point to make attacking it easier. Stun it with the Boomerang and attack it repeatedly.
|image=LoZ OoT enemy Barinade.png
}}
|}

==Adult Link==
===Hyrule Field===
{|{{prettytable|sortable=1}}
!width="200px"|Enemy!!HP!!Damage dealt!!Location first seen!!Locations!!Navi description!!Notes
{{LoZOoT/Enemy
|name=Angry Poe
|hp=??
|damage=??
|first=Hyrule Field
|location=Hyrule Field
|navi=This Poe doesn't disappear even if you stare at it. It doesn't spook easily, does it...
|notes=It is a tougher variant of the Poe. It will not go away, even if Link looks at it. It constantly circles around him and drops flames from its lantern. {{im/oot|Items|Din's Fire}} is very effective if you get cornered by one.
}}
{{LoZOoT/Enemy
|name=Big Poe
|hp=4
|damage=0 hearts
|first=Hyrule Field
|location=Hyrule Field
|navi=This Poe won't disappear even if you stare at it. It moves fast despite its size!
|notes=A limited enemy that only appears when you ride Epona. They never attack, but they like to tease and scare lone travelers. Two shots from the {{im/oot|Items|Fairy Bow}} will slay one, but they do not stick around for very long. Ten Big Poes inhabit Hyrule Field and only appear in certain locations. You can collect their {{im/oot|Items|Big Poe|display=spirits}} and sell them to the keeper of the Ghost Shop to earn Rupees. When he has all ten spirits, you receive another {{im/oot|Items|Empty Bottle}}.
}}
|}

===Kokiri Forest===
{|{{prettytable|sortable=1}}
!width="200px"|Enemy!!HP!!Damage dealt!!Location first seen!!Locations!!Navi description!!Notes
{{LoZOoT/Enemy
|name=Big Deku Baba
|hp=4
|damage=½ heart
|first=Kokiri Forest
|location=Kokiri Forest, Forest Temple
|navi=Hit it when it lunges at you, and it will stand upright. Cut it quickly to get a Deku Stick!
|notes=A huge stationary plant that bite anything that comes into range. Big Deku Babas are more powerful and more dangerous than their smaller counterparts. This plant still has a limited range of attack. Attacking it when it is extended will stun it. Killing it in this stunned position will yield a {{im/oot|Consumables|Deku Stick}} (although they are useless as an adult) while it will drop three {{im/oot|Consumables|Deku Nut|display=Deku Nuts}} if it is not stunned.
}}
|}

===Lost Woods===
{|{{prettytable|sortable=1}}
!width="200px"|Enemy!!HP!!Damage dealt!!Location first seen!!Locations!!Navi description!!Notes
{{LoZOoT/Enemy
|name=Skull Kid
|hp=10
|damage=½ heart
|first=Lost Woods
|location=Lost Woods
|navi=Is this what happens to kids who wander into the forest? It looks like he doesn't like grownups.

}}

===Forest Temple===
{|{{prettytable|sortable=1}}
!width="200px"|Enemy!!HP!!Damage dealt!!Location first seen!!Locations!!Navi description!!Notes

To defeat them, use your {{im/oot|Items|Hookshot}} or let them collide with your shield when they are covered in fire, or shoot them with an arrow and strike the skull twice with your sword once it starts bouncing on the floor (this is easier if you Hook/Longshot it before hand, which immobilizes it).
|image2=LoZ OOT enemy Blue Bubble art.jpg
}}
{{LoZOoT/Enemy
|name=Stalfos
|hp=10
|damage=1 heart (slash), 2 hearts (jump slash)
|first=Forest Temple
|location=Forest Temple
|navi=Lure it close to you and watch its movement carefully! Attack it when it drops its guard!
|notes=A large, armored skeleton that wields a sword and shield. Stalfos attack you at close range with its sword, or at mid-range by jump attacking. Stalfos have proficient blocking skills and are only vulnerable when they are about to attack or immediately after they land from a jump attack. Some Stalfos are capable of regeneration; if their bones remain in a pile once they have been defeated, move quickly to accomplish your objective in the room, or they will regenerate. {{im/oot|Equipment|Biggoron's Sword}} is the best way to defeat these enemies due to its higher attack power.
|image2=LoZ OOT Stalfos art.jpg
}}
{{LoZOoT/Enemy
|name=Wallmaster
|hp=4
|damage=0 hearts
|first=Forest Temple
|location=Forest Temple, Fire Temple (Master Quest), Ice Cavern (Master Quest), Water Temple (Master Quest), Shadow Temple, Gerudo Training Grounds, Spirit Temple, Ganon's Castle
|navi=Watch out for its shadow on the floor. Destroy it before it goes back up to the ceiling!
|notes=A giant decomposing hand that hangs from the ceiling. Its shadow will encircle Link when he nears, and after a few seconds, it will drop down and grab Link, transporting him to the beginning of the dungeon. To avoid getting assaulted by one, continue moving (it begins hovering above you when you have stopped). To kill one easily (this is easier if you play with the sound on,) simply stay in place as the shadow grows around you and you hear a sucking sound. As soon as the sound stops and the shadow starts growing, move out of the way and attack it when it hits the floor. It drops a lot of Rupees when defeated.
}}
{{LoZOoT/Enemy
|name=Floormaster
|hp=1
|damage=1 heart
|first=Forest Temple
|location=Forest Temple
|navi=When it splits up, destroy all the pieces before they reunite!
|notes=A giant decomposing hand that crawls on the floor. If you approach it, it turns green and flies towards you. Avoid its attack by blocking it with your shield, or else it will pick you up and send you to the beginning of the dungeon. When defeated, it splits into three smaller Floormasters. If any of the hands (and it is possible for more than one to do this at the same time) manage to latch onto you, it will suck a large amount of life away before regrowing into a large hand. {{im/oot|Items|Din's Fire}} is a preferred weapon against Floormasters: unleash Din's Fire, and cast it again to defeat the three tiny Floormasters that spawn. 
}}
{{LoZOoT/Enemy
|name=The Poe Sisters: Joelle, Beth, and Amy
|hp=10 (Joelle), 12 (Beth)
|damage=??
|first=Forest Temple
|location=Forest Temple
|navi=Aim for her when she appears!
|notes=These three Poe sisters are included together because they have identical fighting styles. The Poe Sisters are floating Poes holding fiery lanterns, very similar to every other Poe in the game; unlike the other Poes, however, {{control|{{N64|Z}}|{{gc|L}}|{{wii-cc|L}}|{{3ds|L}}|{{Switch|ZL}}}}-targeting does not cause them to disappear. To defeat them, {{control|{{N64|Z}}|{{gc|L}}|{{wii-cc|L}}{{3ds|L}}|{{Switch|ZL}}}}-target and wait with your shield up to deflect their attacks until they reappear; at this point, shoot them with arrows and repeat the process as necessary.
}}
{{LoZOoT/Enemy
|name=Green Bubble
|hp=1
|damage=??
|first=Forest Temple
|location=Forest Temple, Spirit Temple, Ganon's Castle
|navi=Use your sword when its green fire vanishes!
|notes=A close relative to the Blue Bubble. It is covered in a green fire that damages you when you get too close. The fire that surrounds these skulls dissipates intermittently that leaves them vulnerable to attack. One sword slash is enough to dispatch them.
}}
{{LoZOoT/Enemy
|name=Meg
|hp=10
|damage=??
|first=Forest Temple
|location=Forest Temple
|navi=If she splits into multiple images, you need to figure out which one is the real one. Is it this one?
|notes=Meg is the final Poe sister and the Mini-Boss of the Forest Temple. She separates into four identical clones of herself which encircle you. The real Meg spins around occasionally, usually right after she appears. {{control|{{N64|Z}}|{{gc|L}}|{{wii-cc|L}}|{{3ds|L}}|{{Switch|ZL}}}}-Target her and shoot her with your {{im/oot|Items|Hookshot}} or arrows. If you hit the wrong ghost, it will disappear. Hitting the fakes three times will automatically inflict you with unavoidable damage. Do not fight in first-person view since you cannot see all of the ghosts at once. Meg is defeated after being shot by 5 arrows.
}}
{{LoZOoT/Enemy
|name=Phantom Ganon: Evil Spirit from Beyond
|hp=24
|damage=3 hearts (charge), 2 hearts (lightning bolt), 1 heart (energy ball)
|first=Forest Temple
|location=Forest Temple
|navi=(''first phase'') Attack him when he comes out of one of the pictures! Watch out for the fake one!</br>(''second phase'') It's an evil ghost of the Forest Temple! He comes out of one of the pictures. Answer his magic attack with an attack of your own!
|image=LoZ OoT enemy Phantom Ganon.png
|notes=An evil creation of Ganondorf and the boss of the Forest Temple. First, you must shoot Phantom Ganon three times with an arrow as he tries to exit a painting. To make things difficult, Phantom Ganon has his own phantom, riding through the paintings with him. The fake Phantom Ganon turns and heads back into its painting while the real one leaps out of the painting while casting lightning bolts at the Triforce emblem in the middle of the arena. To avoid being hit by the electrical blast, do not stand in the center of the arena, or on the small Triforces that surround it. The best place to stand is right between two of the small Triforce emblems on the floor, which ensures that you will be safe from the electricity. The easiest way to determine the real one is to look at both the paintings they are coming from and find the phantom that looks slightly brighter: the brighter of the two is the real Phantom Ganon. After being hit with 3 arrows, he descends from his horse and float above the arena. In the second phase of the battle you must return Phantom Ganon's energy ball attacks with your sword. You must time your strokes so that you'll deflect the ball of electricity before it hits you. Continuously {{control|{{N64|Z}}|{{gc|L}}|{{wii-cc|L}}}}|{{3ds|L}}|{{Switch|ZL}}}}-Target him to keep your attacks aimed. Shorter distance attacks are more likely to hit him. When you hit him with one of his own spells, run toward him and attack him with your sword. After being hit four times, he will add a new attack: when you see him charge up his staff with a kaleidoscopic light, prepare to move fast. Phantom Ganon will hop on his staff and ride it like a broomstick. If you wait until he targets you and starts his swoop, you can sidestep him and avoid taking damage. Keep reflecting his balls of electricity and move in and strike him until he is defeated. Another way to defeat him is to wait until he gets close to the ground. Then hit him with your sword to stun him. After he falls to the ground hit him with your sword until he gets back up.
|}

}}

{{LoZOoT/Enemy
|name=Flare Dancer
|hp=12
|damage=½ heart (flame scatter), 0 hearts (contact), 1¼ hearts (self-destruct)
|first=Fire Temple
|location=Fire Temple
|navi=Extinguish its flaming clothes first...
|notes=The mini-boss of the dungeon. Only two exist. Its flaming clothes must be extinguished before it can be damaged. Throw a {{im/oot|Items|Bomb|display=bomb}} at it to get the middle to drop, then whack it with your sword. Another, possibly easier way is to use the {{im/oot|Items|Hookshot}} on him when he still dances on the spot. This will drag him towards you and you can slash him with your sword. The Spin attack does a lot of damage. It will run away from you in a circle, but you can change direction to cut it off or use the Hookshot to reel it back in. It will jump into the flames again a few more times when it gets away, and get faster each time. It also changes color for the amount of health it has; red is around full, blue is middle, and green is when its almost dead. Don't stay too close as it dies, as it'll explode like a Dodongo.
}}
{{LoZOoT/Enemy

|notes=The boss of the Fire Temple. The dragon that was sealed away with the {{im/oot|Items|Megaton Hammer}}, and revived by Ganondorf. It can be defeated by hitting with the Megaton Hammer each time it pops out of a lava hole, then slashed with a sword. It eventually becomes unpredictable and will pop out randomly. It can also breathe fire and pummel you with rocks. To avoid being pelted with either attack, cling onto the edge of the platform during each attack. You can also shoot arrows at it when in air to get it to come back down faster.
|image=LoZ OoT enemy Volvagia.png
}}
|}

You could also use {{im/oot|Items|Din's Fire}} when Dark Link gets near you, but you'll want to bring at least 1 {{im/oot|Items|Green Potion}}. He takes many hits to defeat and can cause a lot of damage, so you'll probably want to have at least 1 {{im/oot|Items|Fairy's Spirit|display=fairy}}. It can cause damage to Link if a tentacle hits him, but the damage is much more lethal if it is actually able to grab Link and thrash him around. If you latch onto Morpha with the now-upgraded {{im/oot|Items|Longshot}}, you can pull it out of the water and to you to hit it. After a while, Morpha creates two tentacles at once to avoid.

|navi=(''first phase, Koume'') Ganondorf's surrogate mother. Sorceress of Flame. She seems vulnerable to low temperature.<br>(''first phase, Kotake'') Ganondorf's surrogate mother. Sorceress of Ice. She seems vulnerable to high temperature.<br>(''second phase'') This is the combined form of Kotake and Koume. Turn their magic attack back at them!
|notes=These two witches are the bosses of the Spirit Temple. Kotake attacks you with ice, and Koume with fire. To defeat them, you must deflect the attack of one sister with your {{im/oot|Equipment|Mirror Shield}} and aim it at the other sister. {{control|{{N64|Z}}|{{gc|L}}|{{wii-cc|L}}|{{3ds|L}}{{Switch|ZL}}}}-Targeting is very helpful here. Use it to target the sister who's firing first, and then quickly target the other when she flies by to hit her. After a few hits, they will combine into Twinrova. Twinrova holds two wands of fire and ice that you must avoid. To defeat her, you need to block three attacks of the same kind with the {{im/oot|Equipment|Mirror Shield}}, which will then be released as one big attack. Get close to Twinrova when this happens and aim the shield at her so she gets hit with her own attack. Then, you'll be able to use your sword on her.
|image=LoZ OoT enemy Twinrova Sisters.png
|image2=LoZ OoT enemy Twinrova.png
}}

{{LoZOoT/Enemy
|name=Ganondorf: Great King of Evil
|hp=40
|damage=??
|first=Ganon's Castle
|location=Ganon's Castle
|navi=(''while stunned'')<br>I have no idea what his weak point is!
|notes=Ganondorf is the final boss of the game, and the most dangerous. To defeat the evil king, you must send back the magic attacks he sends at you which can destroy the non-metal platforms by swinging your sword until he is hit, then shoot him with a {{im/oot|Items|Light Arrows|display=Light Arrow}}. After that, you can strike him down with your sword. When Ganondorf is low on health, he'll use his ultimate magic attack on you, which you can deflect with a Super Spin Attack, or just avoid it by using a Light Arrow on him before he fires the attack. The {{im/oot|Equipment|Biggoron's Sword}} is best for this, because it has a longer range when deflecting the magic attack and is more powerful than the {{im/oot|Equipment|Master Sword}}. If you're running low on health or magic, just drop down (rolling will stop you from getting hurt) and break some pots.
|image=LoZOoT Link and Ganon Artwork.jpg
}}
{{LoZOoT/Enemy
|name=Ganon
|hp=40
|damage=??
|first=Ganon's Castle
|location=Ganon's Castle
|navi=I really have no idea what his weak point is!
|notes=The final form of the final boss, Ganon, is a giant monster wielding two large swords. At the start of the battle, you lose the {{im/oot|Equipment|Master Sword}}, and you must use the {{im/oot|Equipment|Biggoron's Sword}} or {{im/oot|Items|Megaton Hammer}} instead. You can strike his head with {{im/oot|Items|Light Arrows}} or a {{im/oot|Items|Deku Nut}} to stun him or run under him to reach his tail. You have to strike Ganon's tail until you have a chance to get the Master Sword. When you do, Ganon will move faster than before, but the strategy is the same. Even when you get the Master Sword back, though, it's faster (and uses fewer Light Arrows, and therefore conserves magic) to use the Biggoron's Sword; however, once Zelda has him held down, the final blow '''must''' be delivered by the Master Sword. If you run out of magic, lead Ganon to a pillar and go behind it to make him smash it to reveal bombs, hearts, arrows, magic jars, or fairies. When Ganon is defeated, you'll be treated to the ending.
|image=LOZ OOT Ganon Artwork.png
}}
